title: Kings View
meta_description: Find the perfect Destin, FL vacation rental at “Kings View”, a Gulf Front luxury 6-bed, 6-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 18 guests, this home offers a Rooftop Deck, Game Room & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Gulf Front - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 -Private Beach Access -Carriage House -Golf Cart Included -6 Adult Bikes -Parking for 5 Vehicles Kings View is a Gulf Front 6 Bedroom Home with a 1 bedroom Carriage house in Destin featuring its own private sand path to the beach. Upon entering the home you enter the open concept living, dining and kitchen area with sweeping gulf views from all areas. One queen bedroom with private bath is located on the first floor. The second floor guests may choose between a queen bedroom with private bathroom with a soaking tub and separate shower, or a bedroom with a queen–over–queen bunk bed and twin trundle with a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The master bedroom with king bed and private bathroom with soaking tub and shower has access to a private balcony with incredible gulf views. The third floor offers two queen bedrooms, one with a private bath with shower/tub and one with a shared bathroom. This floor is also the home to the game room with billiards table and TV sitting area. Separate from the home is a one bedroom carriage house with private bathroom. Kings View guests enjoy exclusive access to Destiny Shores’ fabulous array of amenities within easy walking distance. A guest favorite is the upscale community pool framed with a lushly landscaped pool deck for catching sun rays and graced with a charming gazebo to catch the ocean breezes. A fully equipped Fitness Facility is open to guests. Destiny Shores is one of Destin's most exclusive neighborhoods, primely situated on gorgeous Scenic Gulf Drive running along the shimmering water of the gulf and begging for further exploration of local dining and shopping. The popular Victorian styled Crab Trap Restaurant at James Lee Park is nearby with pavilions and an expansive boardwalk supplying added beach access. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor 1/2 Bath Queen Bedroom with Shower Only Second Floor King Master Bedroom with Shower/Tub separate Queen Bedroom with Shower/Tub separate Queen/Queen with Twin Trundle with Shower/Tub combo Third Floor Two Queen Bedroom with Shower/Tub combo King w/ Twin Day Bed with Shared Bathroom, Shower Only Carriage House Queen Bedroom with Shower Only **Fireplace not for guest use**
